name: DOE FEMP — Purchasing energy-efficient boilers
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. 10 CFR 431.86 based tables: large commercial gas-fired hot-water boilers minimum 96% combustion efficiency; oil-fired 89%; gas/oil steam boilers 83.7%/85.8% thermal efficiency; condensing recovers latent heat but needs corrosion-resistant materials; optimum-start and remote connectivity guidance. Evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/femp/purchasing-energy-efficient-boilers
